name: Diary
description: Daily: runs the `diary` collector (shell, terminal, Claude prompts, git, PRs, Slack, Linear) and distils it into journal entries, learnings and SOPs in the diary vault.
taskPrompt:
Turn the last day of activity into durable notes in the Workshop vault (track slug `diary`). Be terse: the vault is for a tired future reader, not a transcript.

## 1. Collect
```
DIARY="$(command -v diary || echo ~/go/bin/diary)"
ROOT="$(sqlite3 "${WORKSHOP_DB_PATH:-$HOME/.workshop/workshop.db}" "SELECT value FROM settings WHERE key='repo_root';" 2>/dev/null)"
"$DIARY" -since 24h -repos "${ROOT:-$HOME}"
```
If `diary` isn't installed, stop and report: `GOPRIVATE=git.chu.zone go install git.chu.zone/nozzle-industries/diary@latest`.
Also call `workshop_list_todos` for todos that moved to review/done in the last day; their resolutions are the best "what went wrong" signal.
Never copy secrets into the vault, even if the digest missed one. Summarise; never paste raw logs.

## 2. Read before writing
`workshop_vault_list(trackSlug="diary")`, then read `sop-candidates.md`, `learnings.md` and every `sops/*.md` frontmatter. Update an existing note before creating a new one. `workshop_vault_append` only works on files that already exist: create a missing note with `workshop_vault_write` (frontmatter + `# Title`) first.

## 3. Write (skip any that would be empty)
- `journal/YYYY-MM-DD.md` (yesterday): frontmatter `type: journal`, `date`, `tracks`. Sections: **Did**, **Went wrong** (symptom → cause → fix), **Time sinks** (manual work that repeated), **Open threads**.
- `learnings.md`: append `### <title>` only for a non-obvious gotcha with a verified cause (Symptom / Root cause / Fix).
- `sop-candidates.md`: table `| workflow | occurrences (dates) | evidence |`; add or bump a row per hand-done workflow, grouped by intent.
- `sops/<kebab-slug>.md`: promote a candidate at 3+ occurrences on 2+ days, or after one painful incident, and remove its candidate row. Frontmatter `title`, `type: sop`, `status: draft|active`, `trigger`, `last_verified`, `sources`, `tags`. Sections: When to use, Prerequisites (names only, never secret values), Steps (action + exact command + what success looks like), Verify, Rollback, Gotchas. When a new occurrence diverges from an SOP, fix the SOP and bump `last_verified`.
- `_overview.md`: index linking every SOP and the last 7 journal entries.

## 4. Report
Append one line to `progress.md` (date, notes written, candidates promoted) and report the same in two lines. If nothing happened, say so and write nothing else.
